plugin.note: All Lesser Nagua variants have negative flat armour (-4 or -2), so weapons that make multiple hitsplats, such as the Dual Macuahuitl, are generally more effective. They have very high ranged and magic defence bonuses but low melee defence.

requirements: Completion of The Final Dawn for Earthen Nagua in the Crypt of Tonali
75 Hunter to catch moonlight moths for prayer restoration (optional)
mechanics: Sulphur Nagua use a special attack every 5 auto-attacks that drains 5 prayer points unless the player moves out of melee range.
Frost Nagua periodically mark the player's current tile, draining prayer if the player does not move away before the effect triggers.
Earthen Nagua at 60% or lower hitpoints shuffle their melee defences, becoming much weaker to crush while gaining resistance to stab and slash.
All variants have negative flat armour, amplifying multi-hitsplat weapons.
No location is cannonable and only Neypotzli is safespottable.

methods.label: Neypotzli Sulphur Nagua
methods.summary: Fight the 14 Sulphur Nagua in Neypotzli, making supplies freely inside and dodging the prayer-drain special.
requiredOrKeyItems: Dual macuahuitl or another multi-hitsplat weapon
steps: Use a multi-hitsplat melee weapon to exploit the negative flat armour.
Step out of melee range every 5th auto-attack to avoid the 5-prayer-point drain special.
Make moonlight potions inside - they act as super combat, divine super defence, and prayer restoration.
Safespot idle nagua where convenient; Neypotzli is the only safespottable location.

methods.label: Ruins of Tapoyauik Frost Nagua
methods.summary: Fight the 11 Frost Nagua when Konar locks the task to the Ruins of Tapoyauik, moving off marked tiles.
requiredOrKeyItems: Multi-hitsplat melee weapon or fire spells
Butterfly net for moonlight moths (75 Hunter)
steps: Move off your tile when a Frost Nagua marks it to avoid the prayer drain.
Fire spells exploit their 50% elemental weakness.
Catch moonlight moths inside to restore prayer - supplies cannot be made here.
Consider killing the Amoxliatl boss instead for better profit while assigned here.

methods.label: Crypt of Tonali Earthen Nagua
methods.summary: Fight Earthen Nagua in the multicombat eastern sun chamber after The Final Dawn, switching to crush below 60% HP.
recommendedFor: Players with The Final Dawn complete
requiredOrKeyItems: A crush option for the sub-60% phase
steps: Fight in the eastern sun chamber west of the lift platform (multicombat).
Below 60% hitpoints the nagua shuffles its melee defences: switch to crush attacks, which it becomes much weaker to.
A cannon cannot be set up here.
Catch moonlight moths nearby to restore prayer.

methods.label: Amoxliatl boss alternative
methods.summary: Kill Amoxliatl at the Ruins of Tapoyauik as a more profitable alternative when assigned Lesser Nagua there.
steps: Players assigned Lesser Nagua at the Ruins of Tapoyauik may kill Amoxliatl instead.
Brimstone keys only drop when the task was given by Konar quo Maten.

styleOptions.label: Multi-hitsplat melee
styleOptions.summary: Negative flat armour makes multi-hitsplat weapons such as the Dual Macuahuitl especially effective; nagua melee defence is low.

styleOptions.label: Elemental magic
styleOptions.summary: Air spells exploit Sulphur/Earthen Nagua (15%) and fire spells exploit Frost Nagua (50%), though nagua magic defence bonuses vary.
